title: I Got a Voicemail From Inside the House I Was Sitting #shorts #horror
description: The owners said the house would be empty all week. So who left me a voicemail from the upstairs landline? #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: The voicemail came from the upstairs line.

lines.text: I was house-sitting for a couple away for the week.
They said one rule. Never go into the attic.
On the second night, my phone buzzed. New voicemail.
The number was the house landline. Upstairs extension.
I played it. Just slow breathing, then a whisper.
It said, you left the hallway light on.
Then three soft knocks, from above the ceiling.
I called the owners. They answered on the first ring.
They said, we never had a phone put in upstairs.
Then my phone buzzed again. Another new voicemail.
